description: Deterministic, key-free verification tools exposed by the Research Companion MCP trust-layer server (shipped in v0.7.0), plus the costed LLM tools (ask_library, review_draft) shipped behind an explicit opt-in. The costed tools are only exposed when the mcp_costed_tools setting is enabled AND a matching LLM key is configured; every call is capped by the mcp_cost_cap_usd setting and refuses (returning an error/refusal shape instead of raising) once its estimated cost would exceed the cap.

verify_citation.description: Validate a citation against authoritative records (CrossRef/OpenAlex/arXiv).

raw.description: Raw reference string (used when structured fields are absent).

ground_claim.description: Check that a quote appears verbatim in a stored paper's text (exact/whitespace-normalized, never semantic).

citation_coverage.description: Report how much of a draft paper's bibliography is present in the local library.

search_library.description: BM25 keyword search over the local library; returns grounded snippets with char-span provenance.

ask_library.description: LLM Q&A over the local library with cited sources (costed; capped). Exposed only when mcp_costed_tools is enabled and an LLM key is configured; refuses (returns the error/refusal shape below) instead of raising when the estimated cost exceeds mcp_cost_cap_usd.

question.description: Question to answer from the local library.

k.description: Max sections to retrieve as context.

output.description: On success: the answer with sources and provenance. On refusal or failure: {error, estimated_cost_usd?, cap_usd?} — never raises.

review_draft.description: Run the reviewer-style review of a stored paper (costed; capped; read-only). Exposed only when mcp_costed_tools is enabled and an LLM key is configured; refuses (returns the error/refusal shape below) instead of raising when the estimated cost exceeds mcp_cost_cap_usd. fast=true runs only the deterministic lanes (estimate ~$0).

venue.description: Optional target venue for a venue-fit lane.

output.description: On success: the review report. On refusal or failure: {error, estimated_cost_usd?, cap_usd?} — never raises.
